rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for both the discrete-numeric sense and the modern computer-age sense.

example.english: This digital camera takes very clear photos.
example.traditional: 呢部數碼相機影相好清。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sou3 maa5 soeng1 gei1 jing2 soeng2 hou2 cing1

rows.note: Use this for digital technology when the context focuses on electronic devices, services, or media rather than the numeric encoding itself.

example.english: I use digital books to read novels, so I don't have to carry so many books.
example.traditional: 我用電子書睇小說，唔使帶咁多本書。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 din6 zi2 syu1 tai2 siu2 syut3 m4 sai2 daai3 gam3 do1 bun2 syu1

rows.note: Use this when the computer-age sense specifically means that a system or process has been computerized.

example.english: After the clinic went digital, registration became much faster.
example.traditional: 間診所電腦化之後，登記快咗好多。
example.jyutping: gaan1 zan2 so2 din6 nou5 faa3 zi1 hau6 dang1 gei3 faai3 zo2 hou2 do1
